decisions.reason: The cutting and creasing finisher is a core-adjacent distributed product with low carrying cost for a wholesaler, and it complements the firm's service and consumables business.

Although UV spot varnishing is distant from the core offer, it is a flagship premiered at a recent customer event, and an enhancement line takes time to build sales, so dropping it within a year is unlikely.
The sheet preparation module extends the existing modular systems and supports sales of related machines at minimal extra cost.
The B2 multifinisher is a flagship that fits the firm's automation direction squarely, so management will keep pushing it.
The hybrid saddle stitcher fits the core booklet-making business and serves digital printers with short runs, which is the firm's target market.
The folding add-on unit already has a documented customer installation and combines with existing Multigraf systems, which shows it has traction.
